description: This file defines a FirestoreService class that provides an abstraction layer for Firestore database operations. It uses an in-memory map to simulate Firestore functionality, facilitating testing and development without a real Firebase backend.

classes.name: FirestoreService
classes.description: A mock implementation of Firestore operations, providing methods for adding, setting, deleting, and retrieving documents, and streaming collection data in-memory.

methods.name: streamCollection
methods.description: Streams a list of documents from a specified collection for a user as a List<Map<String, dynamic>>.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new document with generated ID to a specified collection for a user.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the data for a specific document ID in a collection for a user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the specified document from a collection for a user.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific document by ID from a collection for a user.
